API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIOrganization DetailsSubscriptions Resource Get Org Status
Subscriptions Resource Get Org Status
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/subscriptions

Retrieves information about the list of subscriptions enabled for your tenant. Subscriptions define the various features and levels of functionality that are available to your organization.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [

string

status
string

The status of the subscription indicating whether it is on trial, expired and disabled, not subscribed, subscribed, or temporarily extended.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, NOT_SUBSCRIBED, SUBSCRIBED, TRIAL, TEMP_EXTENSION, EXPIRED_DISABLED]

state
string

The current state of the subscription indicating whether it is active, expired, disabled, or not started.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, EXPIRED, NOT_STARTED, ACTIVE, DISABLED]

licenses
int32

The number of licenses owned by the tenant under the subscription. The license could be for users, Virtual Service Edges, proxy ports, NSS feeds, etc.

startDate
int32

The subscription start time in Unix time format

strStartDate
string

The subscription start date in MM/DD/YYYY format

strEndDate
string

The subscription end date in MM/DD/YYYY format

endDate
int32

The subscription end time in Unix time format

sku
string

The ID of the service enabled through the subscription

cellCount
string

Specifies the number of cells that can contain data when a template is uploaded to the Advanced Data Protection tool

Possible values: [COUNT_1M, COUNT_50M, COUNT_100M, COUNT_250M, COUNT_500M, COUNT_750M, COUNT_1B, COUNT_1Point25B, COUNT_1Point5B, COUNT_1Point75B, COUNT_2B, COUNT_2Point25B, COUNT_2Point5B, COUNT_2Point75B, COUNT_3B, COUNT_3Point25B, COUNT_3Point5B, COUNT_3Point75B, COUNT_4B, COUNT_4Point25B, COUNT_4Point5B, COUNT_4Point75B, COUNT_5B]

updatedAtTimestamp
int64

The timestamp in Unix time format when the subscription was last updated

subscribed
boolean

A Boolean value indicating that the subscription is active or is not started

]
